reactions.description: Chlorination at the C13 position of hapalindole-type alkaloid substrates by AmbO5.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of 12-epi-fischerindole U into 12-epi-fischerindole G.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of 12-epi-hapalindole C into 12-epi-hapalindole E.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of hapalindole U into hapalindole G.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of ambiguine H into ambiguine A.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of ambiguine C into ambiguine B.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of ambiguine L into ambiguine K.
AmbO5 catalyses the conversion of ambiguine I into ambiguine E.
